name: Quetta

agreement_note: Consistent: 120-day summer NISAR measurement (-3.8 cm LOS, -5.5 cm vertical est., -3.2 cm/100d; ~11.6 cm/yr annualized LOS) sits squarely within published -3 to -16.6 cm/yr Quetta Valley rates. Passed time-series QC with 71.3% valid pixels.
press_summary_gate_note: Approved for atlas #7 rank (passed tools/atlas_qc.py, 71.3% valid pixels, consistent with Kakar et al. 2016).
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
